# Is your S-corp salary defensible — and what does closing the gap cost?

> Free browser calculator for single-shareholder S-corp owners: compare your planned W-2 salary against a comparable-wage figure you supply, see the FICA-tax cost of closing the gap, and get a printable nine-factor documentation checklist for your own records. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
